Based on my research, here are all of the Yamaha Vocaloid voicebanks released in 2023 (excluding beta releases):

## Official Yamaha Vocaloid Voicebanks Released in 2023

| Voicebank | Developer | Release Date | Language(s) |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-------------|
| **Po-uta** | Yamaha Corporation & Sample Sized, LLC | March 7, 2023 | English |
| **Fuiro** | Yamaha Corporation (with nana Music Co., Ltd.) | May 9, 2023 | Japanese, English, Chinese |
| **ZOLA Project (VOCALOID6 Remake)** | Yamaha Corporation | June 20, 2023 | Japanese, English, Chinese |
| **Sakura** | Yamaha Corporation | December 24, 2023 | Japanese |
| **Asahi** | Yamaha Corporation | December 24, 2023 | Japanese |
| **Shion** | Yamaha Corporation | December 24, 2023 | Japanese |
| **Taku** | Yamaha Corporation | December 24, 2023 | Japanese |

### Notes:
- **Po-uta, Fuiro, and ZOLA Project** were sold as standalone downloadable voicebanks via the official VOCALOID SHOP ($90 USD).
- **Sakura, Asahi, Shion, and Taku** were released bundled with the **VOCALOID6 Editor Update 6.3.0** (free update for existing license holders), not sold separately.
- All 2023 releases utilize the **VOCALOID6** engine and **VOCALOID:AI** synthesis technology.
- **AI Otomachi Una** versions (Spicy/Sugar) released June 22, 2023, were developed by **Internet Co., Ltd.**, not directly by Yamaha, so they are excluded from this list as per your question specifying Yamaha voicebanks.
